BiblicalUsage: Nibshan is a town in the wilderness of Judah, listed with the city of Salt and En-gedi among the six cities with their villages. It stands in the desert roll, a place of the wilderness allotment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wilderness towns are counted as carefully as the fertile ones: Nibshan is given and named, though it stands in the desert.
